summary: Locate kitty-graphics APC sequences without altering the byte stream; stop leaking the outer terminal's identity into panes; stop disowning a daemon whose binary is not named `shux`. The load-bearing claim is that the text/render path is bit-identical to the base commit: vte receives every byte unchanged and only its `advance` calls are cut at APC boundaries. No graphics command is acted on and no graphics query is answered yet.
dootsabha_substitution: dootsabha unavailable in this environment. Per CLAUDE.md's Tooling fallbacks table, substituted with two parallel cold-context adversarial agents on disjoint surfaces (APC handling; protocol semantics + diagnosis). Both returned blocking findings that changed the design before any code was written.
method: Rendered 9 workloads through real shux panes on a build of the base commit and on this branch's HEAD, then compared with .claude/automations/pixel_verify.py at exact thresholds (0/0). Each metric carries the two commit SHAs under `provenance`. Workloads: truecolor+indexed+basic colour probes at 80x24 and 120x40; an APC-bearing stream (well-formed kitty graphics, an ESC-aborted APC, an unterminated APC) at both sizes; and replays of all five committed rich-TUI corpus fixtures at the corpus-native 120x36.
harness_corrections: wait-settled was invoked with wrong flags and the error swallowed by `|| true`, so the harness had never settled anything while reporting success. Flags fixed; the call is now unguarded so a settle failure aborts the run.

The pane was sized AFTER the replay started, so a prefix of every stream was parsed at the 80x24 default and reflowed -- btop rendered with 80-column wrapping inside a 120-column frame and vivecaka captured essentially blank. The replay now blocks on a trigger file created only after `pane set-size` returns.
Rich TUIs were replayed at 120x40 while rich-tui/manifest.json declares the recording as 120x36, so the comparison measured reflow. Geometry is now read from the manifest.
Completion was signalled by printing MARKER_DONE into the pane, which overprinted the frame being measured (visible on nvim). It is now signalled out of band via a file.

The combining-mark probe was written as printf '\xNN' under dash, which does not expand it, so it rendered literally. Fixing the escaping alone was not enough: the replacement used a PRECOMPOSED U+00E9, a single scalar that exercises no combining-mark storage. It is now a decomposed `e` + U+0301.

An intermediate revision REMOVED `stty -echo`, claiming the resize race above had been its only cause. That was wrong, and is recorded here because the wrong version was committed. Both bugs are real and independent. Device-query replies (DA1, DECRQM, DSR, OSC 11 -- nvim.raw carries 10, lazygit.raw 5) are echoed into the frame at a position that races the replay. Measured on the nvim arm with one binary: echo ON 35 runs -> 3 distinct images; echo OFF 37 runs -> 1. The earlier removal rested on a 3-run sample, which cannot see a 1-in-10 flake.

The harness leaked one daemon per run and could not tell, because `daemon stop` reported success while leaving it alive. Root cause fixed in shux itself; the harness additionally asserts zero leaked daemons, identified by this run's own unique socket path. That assertion still fires on a base-commit build, which is the cleanest demonstration of the fix.
known_limitations: The `wide: 世界` probe renders as tofu in every arm: the bundled raster font has no CJK. Base-identical and outside this diff, but it means that arm proves wide-cell ACCOUNTING, not glyph rendering.
8-bit C1 APC (0x9F) is deliberately unsupported; see the module docs on graphics::apc.
